I am a PhD Candidate in Economics at the University of Warwick. I am on the 2026-27 job market. 

My research is in Development, Labour and Environmental Economics.

My supervisors are [Anant Sudardhan](https://www.anantsudarshan.com/), [Stefano Caria](https://www.stefanocaria.com/) and [Sharun Mukand](https://profiles.warwick.ac.uk/ecsgam-sharun-mukand/about). 

I am also an Affiliated Scholar at the [Data, Policy and Innovation Centre](https://www.datapolicyinnovationcentre.org/).

You can find my recent work on the [research](research.qmd) page and
download my [CV](files/Bishop_CV.pdf).

My email is menna[dot]bishop[at]warwick.ac.uk.
